## C2 · Extract & Interpretation (runs the Extraction Skill) and links the source to its project
Called for the sources A picked (new projects first). Reads the text from the source library. **Extract & Interpret (GPT-6 Sol)** follows the Extraction Skill, the run's domain module and the experts' worked examples; every field cites the source (original + English). **Verify Evidence** checks each quote occurs in the text and computes the **relevance score** (5 criteria x 20 points). Then **project linking**: the source is matched against known projects (name, organisation, country); close matches are checked by GPT-6 Luna (*same project?*); otherwise a new project is created (P-00012 …). A project is the whole project: the same tool in several places is one project. Reviewers can move or detach a source on the audit page.

### 🧑‍🔬 Skills in
`skills/extraction/SKILL.md`: field definitions and interpretation rules.

`skills/domains/<domain>.md`: the run's domain module: 4 fields, outcome categories.

`skills/extraction/examples/*.md`: the experts' worked examples (a `healthcare-…` file only in Healthcare runs).

-- the source, and the deployment the organiser (stage ②) or a reviewer placed it in, with its tool and its other sources
SELECT s.id, s.url, s.title, s.title_en, s.country, s.language, s.source_type, s.why_relevant, s.project_guess, s.domain, s.screen, s.text_chars,
       p.id AS placed_project_id, p.code AS placed_code, p.name AS placed_name, p.implementing_org AS placed_org, p.countries AS placed_countries,
       p.deployment AS placed_deployment, sp.method AS placed_by, sp.reason AS placed_reason, t.code AS tool_code, t.name AS tool_name,
       t.developer AS tool_developer,
       (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sid', o.id, 'title', COALESCE(o.screen->>'headline_en', o.title_en, o.title),
                                                     'type', o.source_type) ORDER BY o.id), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM source_projects osp JOIN sources o ON o.id = osp.source_id
        WHERE osp.project_id = p.id AND o.id <> s.id AND o.status <> 'duplicate') AS placed_others
FROM sources s
LEFT JOIN source_projects sp ON sp.source_id = s.id AND sp.method IN ('organised', 'manual', 'merged', 'duplicate')
LEFT JOIN ai_projects p ON p.id = sp.project_id
LEFT JOIN ai_tools t ON t.id = p.tool_id
WHERE s.id = $1

WITH e AS (
  INSERT INTO extractions (source_id, fields, flags, relevance_score, status)
  VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4, CASE WHEN $2::jsonb->>'is_ai4sg' = 'false' THEN 'filtered_out' ELSE 'pending_review' END)
  RETURNING id, status
), s AS (UPDATE sources SET status = 'extracted' WHERE id = $1)
SELECT id AS extraction_id, status FROM e

SELECT p.id, p.code, p.name, p.aliases, p.implementing_org, p.countries, p.summary, p.synthesis,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM source_projects sp WHERE sp.project_id = p.id) AS sources
FROM ai_projects p

WITH new_p AS (
  INSERT INTO ai_projects (name, implementing_org, countries, domain, summary, tool_id)
  SELECT $2, NULLIF($3, ''), $4::jsonb, NULLIF($5, ''), $6, ai4sg_tool_for($10, $3) WHERE $7::bigint IS NULL
  RETURNING id
), target AS (
  SELECT id FROM new_p UNION ALL SELECT $7::bigint WHERE $7::bigint IS NOT NULL
), named AS (   -- keep the name this source uses as an alias of the known project
  UPDATE ai_projects p SET updated_at = now(),
         aliases = CASE WHEN lower(p.name) <> lower($2) AND NOT p.aliases @> to_jsonb(ARRAY[$2]::text[]) THEN p.aliases || to_jsonb(ARRAY[$2]::text[]) ELSE p.aliases END,
         tool_id = COALESCE(p.tool_id, ai4sg_tool_for($10, p.implementing_org))
  FROM target t WHERE p.id = t.id AND $7::bigint IS NOT NULL
)
INSERT INTO source_projects (source_id, project_id, method, reason)
SELECT $1, id, $8, $9 FROM target
ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET project_id = EXCLUDED.project_id, method = EXCLUDED.method, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, created_at = now()
RETURNING project_id

UPDATE ai_projects p SET updated_at = now(),
       implementing_org = COALESCE(p.implementing_org, NULLIF($3, '')),
       tool_id = COALESCE(p.tool_id, ai4sg_tool_for($2, COALESCE(p.implementing_org, $3))),
       aliases = CASE WHEN $4 <> '' AND lower(p.name) <> lower($4) AND NOT p.aliases @> to_jsonb(ARRAY[$4]::text[])
                      THEN p.aliases || to_jsonb(ARRAY[$4]::text[]) ELSE p.aliases END
WHERE p.id = $1 RETURNING p.id AS project_id, p.code
